name: Pampliega (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally red over yellow, with a blue bend and a white bend sinister in saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pampliega (grapes, a sword, stars and a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Pampliega; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
bend sinister from the upper fly to the lower hoist
Pampliega arms — grapes, sword, stars and castle
